title: Batch Caption Short Videos on iPhone
description: Auto-caption several short videos on iPhone in one batch. Review each transcript and confirm one checked export for each source clip.
direct: Start a batch with the clips that share a style, review each transcript, and check one output per intended clip.
figureAlt: Photo contact sheet showing three distinct vertical source clips laid across a creator desk: a craft step, a speaking presenter, an overhead cooking demonstration
cards.decision.heading: Group clips that share a style
cards.decision.body: Keep clips with similar framing and caption needs in the same batch. A speaker close to the edge, a title at the bottom or a language change can call for a separate review.
sections.detail-1.heading: Check each output at its intended size
sections.detail-1.body: Watch the final crop, including any existing titles near the bottom. A style that works on a wide clip can cover important content in a vertical one.
sections.detail-2.heading: About the app
sections.detail-2.body: Space Sheep Studio develops this iPhone app. Check the App Store listing for current access and export options.
faqs.first-question.heading: Does a batch combine the clips?
faqs.first-question.body: This workflow captions the clips separately. Check that you receive one file for each selected clip.
faqs.second-question.heading: Is Pro required?
faqs.second-question.body: The current listing places batch captions in Pro. Single-video export terms differ.

steps.step-1.text: In Just Captions, select your clips. Pro supports batches of up to twenty videos. Test a smaller group when trying a new style.
steps.step-2.text: Check each transcript against its own audio. Read names and numbers and play a section where the speaker or background changes.
steps.step-3.text: Export and count the saved videos. Check the first and last lines on each, at the size viewers will see.
